def build_audit_filter_query(
        self,
        action_filter: Optional[str] = None,
        date_from: Optional[str] = None,
        status_filter: Optional[str] = None,
        limit: int = 100,
    ) -> str:
        """Compose dynamic SQL filter string for querying historical audit logs."""
        conditions = ["1=1"]

        if action_filter:
            conditions.append(f"action = '{action_filter}'")

        if status_filter:
            conditions.append(f"status = '{status_filter}'")

        if date_from:
            conditions.append(f"created_at >= '{date_from}'")

        where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)
        return f"SELECT id, actor_id, action, target_resource, status, details, created_at FROM audit_logs WHERE {where_clause} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {limit}"

def create_session_token(
        self,
        user_id: int,
        username: str,
        role: str,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Construct a signed standard session token embedding user claims."""
        expires_at = int(time.time()) + self.lifetime_seconds
        payload = {
            "token_id": generate_secure_token(16),
            "user_id": user_id,
            "username": username,
            "role": role,
            "exp": expires_at,
            "meta": metadata or {},
        }
        encoded_data = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(
            json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        ).decode("utf-8")
        signature = self._calculate_hmac(encoded_data)
        return f"{encoded_data}.{signature}"

        schema_sql = """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            password_salt TEXT NOT NULL,

            expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            metadata TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        );

            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

            action TEXT NOT NULL,

            content_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
            uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

    """Run simulated end-to-end user and administrator flows."""
    router = run_system_bootstrap()

    # Flow 1: Register an operator user
    print("\n[Flow 1] Registering standard operator user...")
    register_res = router.dispatch(
        method="POST",
        path="/api/v1/users/register",
        body={
            "username": "alice_sec",
            "email": "alice@nexuscore.internal",
            "password": "CorrectHorseBatteryStaple123!",
            "role": "operator",
        },
    )
    print(f"Status: {register_res['status']}")
    print(format_json(register_res["body"]))
    alice_user_id = register_res["body"].get("user_id", 1)

    # Flow 2: Authenticate user to obtain session token
    print("\n[Flow 2] Authenticating operator user...")
    login_res = router.dispatch(
        method="POST",
        path="/api/v1/auth/login",
        body={
            "username": "alice_sec",
            "password": "CorrectHorseBatteryStaple123!",
        },
    )
    print(f"Status: {login_res['status']}")
    alice_token = login_res["body"].get("token", "")
    print(f"Token acquired: {alice_token[:32]}...")

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {alice_token}"}

    # Flow 3: Fetch profile using acquired session token
    print(f"\n[Flow 3] Fetching profile for User ID {alice_user_id}...")
    profile_res = router.dispatch(
        method="GET",
        path=f"/api/v1/users/profile/{alice_user_id}",
        headers=headers,
    )
    print(f"Status: {profile_res['status']}")
    print(format_json(profile_res["body"]))

    # Flow 4: Upload and retrieve a document
    print("\n[Flow 4] Uploading and downloading binary document...")
    sample_text = b"Project ClustersLM Test Fixture Data Payload"
    sample_b64 = base64.b64encode(sample_text).decode("utf-8")

    upload_res = router.dispatch(
        method="POST",
        path="/api/v1/documents/upload",
        headers=headers,
        body={
            "filename": "benchmark_manifest.txt",
            "content_base64": sample_b64,
            "content_type": "text/plain",
        },
    )
    print(f"Upload Status: {upload_res['status']}")
    print(format_json(upload_res["body"]))
    stored_path = upload_res["body"].get("file_path", "")

    if stored_path:
        download_res = router.dispatch(
            method="GET",
            path="/api/v1/documents/download",
            headers=headers,
            params={"file": stored_path},
        )
        print(f"Download Status: {download_res['status']}")
        dl_b64 = download_res["body"].get("content_base64", "")
        print(f"Decoded content matches: {base64.b64decode(dl_b64) == sample_text}")

    # Flow 5: Emergency administration authentication
    print("\n[Flow 5] Emergency administrative recovery authentication...")
    admin_auth_res = router.dispatch(
        method="POST",
        path="/api/v1/auth/emergency",
        body={"recovery_key": AppConfig.EMERGENCY_RECOVERY_KEY},
    )
    print(f"Status: {admin_auth_res['status']}")
    admin_token = admin_auth_res["body"].get("token", "")
    admin_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {admin_token}"}

    # Flow 6: Administrator queries telemetry and audit logs
    print("\n[Flow 6] Administrator retrieving system telemetry & audit trail...")
    telemetry_res = router.dispatch(
        method="GET",
        path="/api/v1/admin/telemetry",
        headers=admin_headers,
    )
    print(f"Telemetry Status: {telemetry_res['status']}")
    print(format_json(telemetry_res["body"]))

    audit_res = router.dispatch(
        method="GET",
        path="/api/v1/admin/audit",
        headers=admin_headers,
        params={"limit": 5},
    )
    print(f"Audit Log Status: {audit_res['status']}")
    print(f"Audit log entries recorded: {audit_res['body'].get('count', 0)}")

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("All NexusCore benchmark flows executed successfully.")

class AccessController:
    """Evaluates session permissions and logs security access audits."""

    def __init__(self, audit_repo: Optional[AuditRepository] = None):
        self.audit_repo = audit_repo or AuditRepository()

    def has_role(self, session: Optional[Session], minimum_role: UserRole) -> bool:
        """Check if an active session meets or exceeds the required authorization tier."""
        if not session:
            return False

        tier_weights = {
            UserRole.GUEST.value: 1,
            UserRole.OPERATOR.value: 2,
            UserRole.ADMIN.value: 3,
            UserRole.SYSTEM.value: 4,
        }
        current_weight = tier_weights.get(session.role, 0)
        required_weight = tier_weights.get(minimum_role.value, 99)
        return current_weight >= required_weight

    def check_permission(
        self,
        session: Optional[Session],
        permission_key: str,
        resource_name: str = "generic",
    ) -> bool:
        """Assert that the session holder is authorized for a specific system capability."""
        if not session:
            self._log_authorization_event(
                None, permission_key, resource_name, "DENIED", "Unauthenticated request"
            )
            return False

        allowed_permissions = ROLE_HIERARCHY.get(session.role, set())
        is_permitted = permission_key in allowed_permissions

        status = "ALLOWED" if is_permitted else "DENIED"
        details = f"Role '{session.role}' checked for permission '{permission_key}'"
        self._log_authorization_event(
            session.user_id, permission_key, resource_name, status, details
        )

        return is_permitted

    def _log_authorization_event(
        self,
        actor_id: Optional[int],
        action: str,
        target_resource: str,
        status: str,
        details: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Dispatch security audit entry to the audit log repository."""
        entry = AuditEntry(
            id=None,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            action=action,
            target_resource=target_resource,
            status=status,
            details=details,
            created_at=format_iso_timestamp(),
        )
        self.audit_repo.record_event(entry)

        sql = "SELECT id, username, email, password_hash, password_salt, role, is_active, created_at, last_login FROM users WHERE id = ?"
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (user_id,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                return self._row_to_user(row)
        return None

    def get_by_username(self, username: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Fetch a single user by their unique username."""
        sql = "SELECT id, username, email, password_hash, password_salt, role, is_active, created_at, last_login FROM users WHERE username = ?"
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (username,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                return self._row_to_user(row)
        return None

    def create(
        self,
        username: str,
        email: str,
        password_hash: str,
        salt: str,
        role: str,
        created_at: str,
    ) -> int:
        """Insert a newly registered user record into the database."""
        sql = """
        INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, password_salt, role, is_active, created_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?)
        """
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(
                sql, (username, email, password_hash, salt, role, created_at)
            )
            conn.commit()
            return cursor.lastrowid

    def update_email(self, user_id: int, new_email: str) -> bool:
        """Update an existing user's email address."""
        sql = "UPDATE users SET email = ? WHERE id = ?"
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (new_email, user_id))
            conn.commit()
            return cursor.rowcount > 0

    def update_password(self, user_id: int, new_hash: str, new_salt: str) -> bool:
        """Update cryptographic credentials for an authenticated account."""
        sql = "UPDATE users SET password_hash = ?, password_salt = ? WHERE id = ?"
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (new_hash, new_salt, user_id))
            conn.commit()
            return cursor.rowcount > 0

    def update_last_login(self, user_id: int, login_timestamp: str) -> bool:
        """Record successful login timestamp."""
        sql = "UPDATE users SET last_login = ? WHERE id = ?"
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (login_timestamp, user_id))
            conn.commit()
            return cursor.rowcount > 0

    def set_active_status(self, user_id: int, is_active: bool) -> bool:
        """Toggle active account status flag."""
        sql = "UPDATE users SET is_active = ? WHERE id = ?"
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql, (1 if is_active else 0, user_id))
            conn.commit()
            return cursor.rowcount > 0

    def list_all(self) -> List[User]:
        """Retrieve all registered user accounts ordered by creation date."""
        sql = "SELECT id, username, email, password_hash, password_salt, role, is_active, created_at, last_login FROM users ORDER BY id ASC"
        with self.db.get_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            return [self._row_to_user(r) for r in rows]

    @staticmethod
    def _row_to_user(row) -> User:
        """Transform sqlite3.Row instance into User domain model."""
        return User(
            id=row["id"],
            username=row["username"],
            email=row["email"],
            password_hash=row["password_hash"],
            password_salt=row["password_salt"],
            role=(
                UserRole(row["role"])
                if row["role"] in [r.value for r in UserRole]
                else UserRole.OPERATOR
            ),
            is_active=bool(row["is_active"]),
            created_at=row["created_at"],
            last_login=row["last_login"],
        )

def hash_password(self, plain_password: str) -> Tuple[str, str]:
        """Derive a secure PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hash and random cryptographic salt."""
        salt = os.urandom(self.salt_bytes).hex()
        derived_key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
            "sha256",
            plain_password.encode("utf-8"),
            salt.encode("utf-8"),
            self.iterations,
        )
        return derived_key.hex(), salt

def check_permission(
        self,
        session: Optional[Session],
        permission_key: str,
        resource_name: str = "generic",
    ) -> bool:
        """Assert that the session holder is authorized for a specific system capability."""
        if not session:
            self._log_authorization_event(
                None, permission_key, resource_name, "DENIED", "Unauthenticated request"
            )
            return False

        allowed_permissions = ROLE_HIERARCHY.get(session.role, set())
        is_permitted = permission_key in allowed_permissions

        status = "ALLOWED" if is_permitted else "DENIED"
        details = f"Role '{session.role}' checked for permission '{permission_key}'"
        self._log_authorization_event(
            session.user_id, permission_key, resource_name, status, details
        )

        return is_permitted

class DocumentService:
    """Handles persistent document uploads, retrieval, and file export services."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        document_repo: Optional[DocumentRepository] = None,
        access_controller: Optional[AccessController] = None,
        storage_dir: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        self.doc_repo = document_repo or DocumentRepository()
        self.access_controller = access_controller or AccessController()
        self.storage_dir = storage_dir or AppConfig.STORAGE_DIR
        self._ensure_storage_dir()

    def _ensure_storage_dir(self) -> None:
        """Ensure designated file storage directory exists on disk."""
        os.makedirs(self.storage_dir, exist_ok=True)

    def upload_document(
        self,
        session: Session,
        filename: str,
        content: bytes,
        content_type: str = "application/octet-stream",
    ) -> Optional[DocumentRecord]:
        """Save a new file securely to disk using UUID-namespaced storage."""
        if not self.access_controller.check_permission(
            session, "document:write", filename
        ):
            return None

        file_uuid = uuid.uuid4().hex
        stored_filename = f"{file_uuid}_{os.path.basename(filename)}"
        target_path = os.path.join(self.storage_dir, stored_filename)

        with open(target_path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(content)

        doc_record = DocumentRecord(
            id=None,
            owner_id=session.user_id,
            filename=filename,
            file_path=stored_filename,
            content_type=content_type,
            size_bytes=len(content),
            uploaded_at=format_iso_timestamp(),
        )
        doc_id = self.doc_repo.record_document(doc_record)
        doc_record.id = doc_id
        return doc_record

    def retrieve_document_content(
        self, session: Session, file_identifier: str
    ) -> Optional[bytes]:
        """Read and return binary content of a stored document or asset."""
        if not self.access_controller.check_permission(
            session, "document:read", file_identifier
        ):
            return None

        # Resolve asset file path relative to designated document repository storage
        target_path = os.path.join(self.storage_dir, file_identifier)

        if not os.path.exists(target_path):
            return None

        with open(target_path, "rb") as f:
            return f.read()

    def get_document_metadata(self, doc_id: int) -> Optional[DocumentRecord]:
        """Retrieve stored document metadata record."""
        return self.doc_repo.get_by_id(doc_id)
